Overview

Boa Vista is a city in RR with a population of 436,591. The only Brazilian state capital north of the Equator, offering a unique blend of Amazonian and savanna landscapes. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 100 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
